svg.title: What engineers were being asked to engineer, by year
svg.desc: Four eras from the same conference archive. May 2024, the prompt: a four-rung menu of prompt, retrieval, fine-tune or train from scratch, with agents absent. August 2025, retrieval and tools: MCP, A2A, LangGraph and ReAct all first appear in the archive on the same day, and context engineering is already named as a discipline. March to May 2026, context: the protocol stack is taught as one subject and three consecutive talks call context the scarce resource. August 2026, the loop: a session titled Loop Engineering, another arguing memory is the harness, and a slide showing scaffolding deleted between model versions to cut cost.
svg.text: MAY 2024
The prompt
Four rungs on offer: prompt · retrieve · fine-tune · train.
Agents are not on the ladder. Gen AI is one tile on the stack diagram.
AUG–SEP 2025
Retrieval, then tools
MCP, A2A, LangGraph and ReAct all first appear on one day.
Context engineering is already named as a discipline.
A bank presents an A2A deep-dive four weeks later.
MAR–MAY 2026
Context
The protocol stack is taught as one subject: MCP + A2A + context.
Three consecutive talks call context the scarce resource.
A cloud vendor ships an agent runtime, registry and evaluations.
AUG 2026
The loop
A session titled Loop Engineering. Another: the memory is the harness.
Scaffolding deleted between model versions, cost down 38%.
The work is now the loop around the model, not the call to it.
Dates are first appearance in one photographed archive, not industry-wide firsts.
